# Phase Three — Critique and Final Plan

The Awtsmoos renews the plan before the plan can become a throne; Awtsmoos.com therefore turns every attractive abstraction back toward evidence, tests, and the user-visible road.

## Thirty failure-prevention improvements

1. Read full target files before rewrite.
2. Trace exports and outside call sites first.
3. Preserve `createSocialHub(root)` and direct app property consumers.
4. Keep route coordinator authoritative for route loading.
5. Keep one realtime transport owner.
6. Add identity generations only where stale async completion is demonstrable.
7. Report partial social reload failure honestly.
8. Never equate unknown relationship state with false.
9. Optimistic follow requires rollback snapshot.
10. Search debounce never substitutes for abort/cancellation.
11. Pagination rejects stale mode/query pages.
12. Inbox unread derives from typed records when possible.
13. Message semantics never exceed backend evidence.
14. Realtime dedupe requires stable IDs or explicit composite keys.
15. Draft persistence is bounded and identity-aware.
16. Media state distinguishes cancellation, validation, transport, and server rejection.
17. Mobile sheets restore focus.
18. Every fixed surface reserves space.
19. Semantic layer tokens remain route-local.
20. Pointer hover motion is capability-gated.
21. Reduced motion preserves state clarity.
22. New JS authorities receive focused tests.
23. New procedural seeds use named child streams.
24. Remote texture cache ownership/disposal is explicit.
25. Procedural recursion/subdivision is quality-budget bounded.
26. Semantic creature sockets survive quality tiers.
27. Generated materials fail soft with deterministic fallback.
28. Every touched file gets full readback and indentation/minification scans.
29. Planned-vs-actual delta becomes remaining work.
30. Browser limitations are reported as limitations, never invented proof.

## Exact immediate NEXT_ACTION

Read current Social state/navigation/route/realtime/assembly/lifecycle files and constructor signatures in small batches. Then rewrite the first Social lifecycle/assembly wave as complete files. Code first, tests second. After proof, move into relationship convergence, then procedural-core API/material foundations.
